visual_logic.surface_detail: Fine, smooth scales with 'Turquoise' and 'Oceanic Cyan' dappled patterns for camouflage, running continuously along its horizontal profile.
visual_logic.environment: Sun-drenched shallow water. The 'Ancestral Seagrass' and school of small prehistoric fish are pushed entirely into the distant background layers to preserve a clean, measurable silhouette line.
visual_logic.lighting_logic: Midday sun creating crisp shadows on the seafloor to ground the 3D model, with light elements smoothed to keep the lateral boundaries sharp.

pose: The marine reptile is oriented entirely in a strict lateral profile view, swimming horizontally from left to right parallel to the frame boundaries. The original dynamic, predatory neck curve is completely unrolled and stabilized into a flat, level cruising path, allowing its head, elongated torso, paddling limbs (flattened toward the camera plane), and tail to stretch end-to-end to trace flawlessly alongside the central UI measuring tape system.
